records.title: Frequent Power Outrages in Rural and Tribal Areas of Bardoli
details: c to d: Further, DGVCL has also prepared an action plan for the Bardoli Lok Sabha constituency under various schemes of Government of Gujarat viz. System Improvement (SI), Robust-SI, Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana-2 (VKY-2), Kisan Suryoday Yojana (KSY), and Sardar Krushi Jyoti Yojana (SKJY) with a total cost of Rs. 316 crore. The timeline for completion of works under all these schemes is FY 2025-26 except for Robust-SI for which the timeline is FY 2026-27.

records.title: Investment in Textile Sector
details: Part (c)&(d): PM MITRA Parks Scheme: Under the scheme, 7 Mega Textile Parks with modern, integratged, large-scale, world-class infrastructure and plug and play facility are being set up to attract investments in the textile sector and boost employment.
